shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/test-commands.yml; cat package.json; sed -n '115,160p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts; cat tsconfig.json; git status --short"
/bin/zsh -lc 'head -35 node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.d.ts; tail -10 node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.js; ls scripts/spec-links; cat jest.config.js; cat CHANGELOG.md | head -30'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts'
s=open(p).read().replace(\"    log.info('tool', 'executing', {name, inputKeys: Object.keys(input)});\", \"    if (typeof tool.definitionSource === 'function') {\\n      const {inputSchema} = this.resolveDefinition(tool.definitionSource);\\n      if ("'!this.validators.has(inputSchema)) {'"\\n        this.validators.set(inputSchema, this.ajv.compile(inputSchema));\\n      }\\n    }\\n    log.info('tool', 'executing', {name, inputKeys: Object.keys(input)});\")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='.lore/dod.md'
s=open(p).read().replace('- [ ] Cache compiled validators for function-valued', '- [x] Cache compiled validators for function-valued')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.dynamic.test.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.dynamic.test.ts | head -12; rg -n \"it\\('\" src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts; git diff --stat; git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts'
s=open(p).read(); start=s.index('        {\\n          const lastMessage'); end=s.index('\\n      },\\n      async generateStructured',start); part=s[start:end]; part=part[len('        {\\n'):]; part=part.rsplit('\\n        }',1)[0]; part='\\n'.join(line[2:] for line in part.split('\\n')); part=part.removesuffix('\\n        return;'); s=s[:start]+part+s[end:]; open(p,'w').write(s)
p='specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md'; s=open(p).read().replace('registry.dynamic.test.ts#L4','registry.dynamic.test.ts#L5'); open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
git status --short"

/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.dynamic.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m 'Cache dynamic tool schema validators' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main --no-edit && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb"
